Markets.title: Stocks in news: Tata Group, Wipro, BEL, HAL, Petronet LNG and Bharat Forge
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices showed mixed movement on September 17, with the Nifty rising and the Sensex falling slightly amid market volatility. Major companies making news include Tata Group, Wipro, Bharat Electronics, HAL, Petronet LNG, and Bharat Forge.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian equities are expected to remain cautiously positive following the recent Federal Reserve rate hike, with market resistance set at 23,300. On Thursday, domestic investors bought shares while foreign investors sold them, and the rupee ended the session with a small loss against the US dollar.

Markets.title: Sebi to examine discount brokers’ concerns over new UPI MDR
Markets.summary: Sebi is examining discount brokers' concerns regarding new UPI charges that will impact large fund transfers starting October 15. Brokers worry these fees and quarterly settlement complexities will significantly increase their operating expenses.

Markets.title: Tata stocks rise on listing hopes, Chandra's extension
Markets.summary: Tata Sons reappointed N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for five years, boosting Tata stock prices on expectations of a potential public listing. However, Tata Trusts declared the reappointment legally void, creating governance tensions that could delay these strategic plans and shareholder value.

Markets.title: Market rides out 'expected' US rate hike, Nifty up 0.2%
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets closed slightly higher on Thursday after digesting the anticipated 25-basis-point interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve. Domestic institutional buying helped offset foreign investor sell-offs as bond yields eased and oil prices corrected.

Markets.title: NSE IPO subscribed 0.43 times on day 1, NII bids highest
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange's initial public offering was subscribed 0.43 times on its first day, driven mostly by non-institutional investors. The offer for sale, which allows existing shareholders to sell their stakes without raising new capital, remains open until September 25.

Geo-Political.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed a European Union proposal for Canada to become an associate member. Carney stated that this alliance between Canada and the EU would create a beacon for other democracies.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police are investigating the discovery of nine women's bodies in a series of deaths. Although authorities caution against assuming the killings are connected, local women remain fearful.

Geo-Political.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
Geo-Political.summary: United Nations experts state there are grounds to believe the United States committed war crimes during February airstrikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd. The United States has not acknowledged carrying out these deadly attacks in Iran.

Geo-Political.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
Geo-Political.summary: The United States will permit an Iranian delegation, including President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, to enter the country for United Nations meetings in New York. This diplomatic development occurs as the ongoing war passes its six-month mark.

Geo-Political.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Sylvia Zin and other family members of individuals imprisoned in China are asking President Trump to raise these arrests with China's leader during their upcoming meeting next week. Zin is specifically seeking Trump's help to secure the release of her husband, a U.S. scholar jailed in China.

Geo-Political.title: Hyrox athlete apologises for continuing race after soiling herself
Geo-Political.summary: Hyrox athlete Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized and forfeited her recent race win after continuing to compete after soiling herself. The fitness competition incident occurred last week, prompting her public statement and relinquishment of the title.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This finding led them to test and reconsider strategies for obtaining organic traffic through artificial intelligence.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay ahead in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various applications.

AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audience. Because numerous tools are available on the market, choosing the right one for your specific needs can be challenging.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre is hosting a conference for state finance ministers on October 7 to discuss financing "Viksit Bharat." This meeting precedes the upcoming GST Council session and the start of pre-budget consultations for the 2027-28 Union Budget.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. His administration has also driven welfare expansion, technological transformation, national-security shifts, and foreign policy changes.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea warns that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs, significantly changing the employment landscape in India. This shift will lead to a decline in traditional salaried positions and promote a greater reliance on gig work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: In July, India increased its US Treasury holdings by $15.2 billion, reaching its highest level in 10 months. This surge was driven by large capital inflows facilitated by the central bank's special overseas investment programs.

Data & Insights.title: India flags impact on ties, energy markets from US law on Russian oil imports
Data & Insights.summary: The US House passed a bipartisan sanctions bill giving the president power to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries like India and China for buying Russian energy. India warned this legislation could negatively impact bilateral relations and global energy markets.

Data & Insights.title: In charts: How India’s Russian oil imports shifted amid US tariff flip-flops
Data & Insights.summary: India's reliance on Russian oil has surged significantly, complicating the country's ongoing energy-security diversification. Consequently, India now faces potential 100% US tariffs under new legislation targeting buyers of Russian energy.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Raped, Stabbed To Death In Delhi
India.summary: A 17-year-old girl was sexually assaulted and stabbed to death in Delhi by acquaintances she had been drinking with inside a tempo. The accused individuals then disposed of her body after committing the crime.

India.title: 6-Month-Old Critical After Pit Bull Attack In Haryana's Sonipat, CCTV Captures Horror
India.summary: A six-month-old baby is in critical condition after being attacked and dragged by a pit bull in Sonipat, Haryana. CCTV footage captured bystanders attempting to rescue the child as the dog refused to let go.

India.title: Call For 9% Sub-Quota For Bhils Out Of ST Share, High Court Issues Notices
India.summary: The Rajasthan High Court has issued notices regarding a petition demanding a 9% sub-quota for the Bhil community within the Scheduled Tribe reservation share. The petitioners argue that the Meena community has received the majority of reservation benefits, leaving the Bhils with inadequate representation.

India.title: PM Modi's Teacher Recalls Sharp Memory, Courage, And A Baby Crocodile
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi's former science teacher, HC Patel, remembered him as a courageous student with a sharp memory during his high school years in Vadnagar. Patel also recalled an incident where Modi once brought a baby crocodile to school.

India.title: Tata Sons' Trust Issue: Two-Pronged Row Goes Beyond The Chair
India.summary: The conflict at Tata Sons involves more than just whether N Chandrasekaran will continue as executive chairman. This two-pronged row encompasses at least one additional unspecified issue.

India.title: 2 Rajya Sabha Members Made Special Invitees To Joint Panel On FCRA Bill
India.summary: Two Rajya Sabha members have been appointed as special invitees to the joint parliamentary committee examining the FCRA Bill. Such joint committees are formed to review specific bills and conclude their work after submitting a report.

General.title: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
General.summary: Police have identified the remains of Joanne Sheen, a mother-of-three missing since 2019, following a wildfire in London. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the case.

General.title: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
General.summary: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that King Charles sounded giddily elated following the death of Princess Diana. Buckingham Palace has strongly pushed back against these claims.

General.title: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
General.summary: Government and military officials warn that the risk of a major conflict is increasing. However, the public may lack the psychological preparedness needed to cope with such a war.

General.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
General.summary: Researchers in Bolivia have identified a spotted wildcat as a new species. Only one living member of this newly discovered species is currently known.

General.summary: Rhys Woods pays tribute to his three-year-old son and offers "deepest gratitude" to local people.
